## Swift Package Manager

Use this version tag with the repository URL in Xcode or your `Package.swift` dependency requirement. GitHub provides source archives automatically; no prebuilt binary framework is required.

This release does not bundle original recordings, trained model weights, feedback databases, or generated audio. For synthesis, supply a compatible portable model export from your own local training workflow. Check the README at this tag for the APIs and platforms available in this version.

Experimental APIs and sound/detection quality are subject to the limitations documented in the README. Version tags should be treated as immutable.
